description: This Java class 'FineractConfigLoader' loads configuration classes for functional testing in the Apache Fineract project by reading a configuration file and dynamically loading classes specified within it.

classes.name: FineractConfigLoader
classes.description: Utility class for loading initializer configuration classes for Fineract tests.

methods.name: getInitializerConfigurationClasses
methods.description: Loads and returns configuration classes specified in the test configuration file.
